newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end down, spreads vs Bunds widens.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end down, spreads vs Bunds widens.

text.p: Portuguese cash bonds and futures ended weaker and spreads against 10-year Bunds widened to more than 75 basis points as the market nervously awaited Sunday's Ecofin meeting and the escudo slipped against the mark. *June 97 futures down 0.20 points to 109.25 *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 100.65 (100.85), yld 6.52 (6.50) *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 76 bps vs 68 bps

Portuguese bonds ended weaker amid nervousness over the outcome of Sunday's Ecofin meeting as the escudo slipped against the mark, and yield spreads against 10-year Bunds widened sharply to 76 basis points.
"The Ecofin meeting and the drop in the escudo triggered selling of Portuguese bonds," a dealer said.
A fixed income analyst said: "In the afternoon there was buying of Bunds and selling of peripherals, which augurs badly for the Ecofin meeting."
He added: "There are fears of a delay in the launch of the euro. I see some selling pressure at the long end of the curve."
